exposure: Levels of specific miRNAs in umbilical cord blood (miR-486-5p, miR-126-5p, miR-140-3p, miR-151a-3p, miR-142-5p, and miR-30e-5p)
Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs. Natural spontaneous delivery)
finding: miRNA levels in umbilical cord blood at birth, particularly miR-140-3p and miR-142-5p, were associated with cognitive and language development at 1 year of age.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered via natural spontaneous delivery had significantly higher ΔCt values for miR-486-5p and lower ΔCt values for miR-126-5p and miR-151a-3p in their cord blood compared to those delivered via Cesarean section.
